title: LOB Latent Regime Detection — Crash Precursor Concept for R35
rationale: This paper formalizes a three-regime causal model (stable → latent build-up → stress) with provable early-warning guarantees (+18.6 timestep mean lead on simulation, +38 second lead on live BTC/USDT LOB data). The 'latent build-up' concept is novel for R35 regime stack: current stack (EF clustering, Wasserstein HMM, skewness dispersion, RMT gap) detects CURRENT stress but not PRE-STRESS buildup. The two key signals — depth erosion and HMM entropy — are LOB-level and not directly computable from yfinance. However, the conceptual framework maps to daily data proxies worth testing.
content:
### LOB Latent Regime Detection — Pre-Crash Buildup Signal (arXiv:2604.20949, April 2026)
- **Paper**: 'Early Detection of Latent Microstructure Regimes in Limit Order Books' — Hiremath & Hiremath. arXiv:2604.20949, April 22, 2026.
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/prakulhiremath/LOB-Latent-Regimes
- **Core innovation**: Three-regime causal model (stable → LATENT BUILD-UP → stress) with two theoretical guarantees: (1) identifiability of the latent regime under mild conditions, (2) closed-form probability bound on detection before stress onset. The detection window (the latent build-up phase) is the novel contribution.
- **Performance**:
  - Simulation (200 runs): Mean lead-time +18.6 ± 3.2 timesteps, precision 1.00 ± 0.00, coverage 0.54
  - Live BTC/USDT LOB data (1 week, 5 stress events): Mean lead-time +38 ± 21 seconds, precision 1.00, coverage 0.80
  - All baselines (CUSUM, BOCPD, HMM) show NEGATIVE lead-times (react after stress onset)
- **Two dominant signals** (drive >99% of detections):
  1. **Depth erosion**: Systematic reduction in resting limit order depth on both sides of the book — market makers are quietly withdrawing before a move
  2. **HMM entropy**: Rising uncertainty in hidden market state transitions — the LOB microstructure becomes ambiguous before a directional break
- **Implementation challenge for George**: Both signals require live LOB data (level-2 order book). yfinance provides OHLCV only — depth erosion and order flow are NOT available. Direct implementation is not feasible with current data pipeline.
- **Conceptual proxies for daily yfinance data** (untested, exploratory):
  - Depth erosion proxy: OHLCV spread expansion (High-Low / Close > rolling 90th pctile) as a crude market-maker withdrawal signal
  - HMM entropy proxy: rising entropy of the existing Wasserstein HMM state posterior (already computed in R35 stack)
- **R35 Regime Stack Note**: Add 'latent build-up detection' as a conceptual 5th layer to R35. Implementation requires LOB data upgrade. Defer until Kevin secures a live data feed beyond yfinance (Polygon.io, IEX Cloud, or IBKR provide level-2 data). File the daily-proxy approach as an experiment within R35 implementation.
- **Source**: arXiv:2604.20949 — April 2026
